description: July 11 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 2, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 11 birthday falls in Cancer, in the second decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: July 11 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Master number 11 lands on the 11th of July in Cancer's Pluto decan, around eighteen degrees along. Intuition is a recurring word in descriptions of this birthday: an ability to read moods, sense hidden motives and anticipate needs. Kept unreduced in numerology, 11 suggests inspiration; in a water sign it often shows up as emotional insight that guides others.

On July 11 the Sun usually sits at about 18° Cancer, in the second decan, where Pluto is the sub-ruler alongside Moon. In the middle of Cancer, from 10 to 19 degrees, the sub-ruler is Pluto, the modern ruler of Scorpio. That brings an intensity to the Crab's tenderness. Early-July birthdays are often linked with emotional depth, loyalty that runs very deep, and a sharp instinct for what goes unsaid in a room. These Cancerians tend to protect privately and completely, sometimes keeping their own needs hidden behind the shell. Pluto adds resilience and a capacity for real renewal after loss. Learning to trust selectively, rather than all or nothing, usually helps the intensity become a source of steadiness instead of strain.

sections.heading: July 11 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 11th, you have a birthday number of 11, and because it is a master number it stays unreduced. The day of birth is a secondary number in numerology, yet master numbers are traditionally given extra weight wherever they appear. Two 1s side by side suggest doubled sensitivity as well as doubled initiative: the 11 is linked with intuition, inspiration and a nervous, creative charge. Those born on this date are often described as idealistic and perceptive, sometimes picking up on things before they can explain why. Grounding routines and trusted company tend to help them carry that intensity comfortably.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one July 11 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22.

sections.heading: Born on July 11: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 11 is the 192nd day of the year (193rd in a leap year). By July 23, 12 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Leo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 11, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on July 11 include John Quincy Adams (1767), Alexander Prokhorov (1916) and Giorgio Armani (1934).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 11?
faq.answer: July 11 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 11?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 11 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 2 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 22 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 11th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 11?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 11 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 11?
faq.answer: July 11 is also the birthday of John Quincy Adams (1767), Alexander Prokhorov (1916) and Giorgio Armani (1934). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
